independence: Reviewer authored the separate pine/olive families, not the grass family. No grass model, texture, preview or source script was modified during this review.
scope: Offline independent visual review of all eight field-grass variants and their 80-triangle lowest LODs. Includes fitted hero pairs, selected current distance pairs, independent saved-PNG decoding and evidence hash checks.
summary: The family meets the specified size and triangle ranges and the late-September palette: A-D are mostly dry straw, E/F visibly greener, patch A dry and patch B mixed. Final lowest LODs retain distinct visible clumps and distributed patch/scatter coverage at 150 m without a collapsing central void. Lowest LODs are noticeably simpler and thinner than the detailed meshes; they are suitable far proxies, not close substitutes.

brief_checks.budget_summary: Clumps LOD0 2072-2908 triangles; patches LOD0 7420 each; all eight LOD3 meshes 80 triangles.
brief_checks.geometry: Detailed meshes use closed bent grass blades, stems, awns/drooping seed heads and occasional broadleaf weeds. Lowest meshes use twenty pointed closed tetrahedral tufts, never billboards.
brief_checks.pivot_and_axes: All pivots are at ground centre, minimum Z approximately 0; metre units and FBX -Y forward / Z up.
brief_checks.geometry_qa: Final source and fresh-FBX checks report finite vertices/normals/UV0, zero zero-area triangles, zero boundary or nonmanifold edges, matching triangle counts and matching ground pivots.
brief_checks.material_slots: Eight shared slots retain identical names/order within every high/low pair, including unused slots. The low roles carry separate darkened BaseColor PNGs, with the same Normal/ORM roles.
brief_checks.materials: Opaque, two-sided, alpha 1; no wind or collision. Sixteen original 1K PNGs include sRGB BaseColor, OpenGL +Y Normal and ORM R=AO/G=roughness/B=metallic.
brief_checks.independent_texture_check: All 16 saved PNGs independently decoded as 1024x1024 RGBA8; every alpha byte is 255. Low BaseColor pixels are darker, consistent with the documented 0.70 linear albedo calibration.

appearance.Clump_A_D: Predominantly dry golden straw, sparse green blades and weeds.
appearance.Clump_E_F: Clearly greener annual-grass mix with dry seed details.

visual_findings.finding: All eight fitted high/low pairs were inspected. No floating bases, inverted orientation, missing patch section or gross scale defect was observed.

After final B/C/D widening, the 150 m scatter retains its population pattern and dry/green mixture. Individual tufts remain present; patches maintain distributed cover, including their central region.

The low meshes lose fine blade and seed silhouettes. At 150 m the scatter has 0.75479 of the detailed alpha-weighted area; individual clumps retain about 0.648-0.712. This is visible thinning, not identical density.
visual_findings.action: Inspect the native HLOD transition over the actual ground. Keep the current 80-triangle far proxies for handoff; do not claim exact density preservation.

visual_findings.finding: Patch LOD3s read as angular separated mounds at 15-50 m and change local holes/silhouette compared with fine grass. At 150 m their footprint remains distributed and their area ratios are 0.85305 and 0.82331.
visual_findings.action: Use them as distant representations; keep detailed meshes while the patch is large on screen. Choose the native LOD/HLOD transition from scene evidence rather than treating 15 or 50 m test frames as an approved switch distance.

visual_findings.finding: F and dry patch A are somewhat darker at 150 m (luma changes -5.913 and -6.257 display code values); the green/straw distinction survives and there is no bright bleaching.
visual_findings.action: Preserve calibrated low material assignments on import and judge the remaining tonal difference in destination lighting.

clump_C_150m.judgement: Nonblocking. The 0.65 band is a review heuristic, not a brief requirement. The final image remains a coherent dry tuft, its colour is close, and the tiny threshold miss does not justify another geometry edit merely to cross the number.

diagnostic_flags_judgement.six_patch_iou_flags: Both patches flag IoU below 0.55 at 15, 50 and 150 m. Accepted with the explicit near-view limitation: an 80-triangle group of mounds cannot trace thousands of blades, but final 150 m coverage exceeds 0.82 of the detailed version, the footprint and colour class survive, and there is no collapsing field-density or central-hole defect in the inspected far views.

settings.distance_definition: Euclidean camera-to-declared-target slant distance in metres
settings.png: RGBA8 display sRGB, original unrescaled 1920x1080 evidence

distance_evidence.visual_scope: All eight fitted hero pairs; all eight single high/low pairs at 150 m; both patches and mixed 10x10 m scatter at 50/150 m; A/E/Patch B samples at 15 m. Final B/C/D heroes and 150 m singles plus final scatter were re-inspected after the last geometry change.
distance_evidence.resolution_limit: The smallest A/E lowest clumps occupy only about 2.6/2.8 equivalent opaque pixels at 150 m. Geometry persistence does not guarantee a perceptible plant at arbitrary distance or resolution.
distance_evidence.crop_and_magnification_limit: Fitted orthographic heroes show construction only. Fixed-camera distance PNGs use the declared perspective rig; close cropped frames are not whole-object coverage proof. Nearest-neighbour enlarged pairs add no image detail.

remaining_native_limits: Unreal import/material assignment, forced non-Nanite LOD3 in always-loaded Instancing HLOD, and actual native transition behaviour remain unverified.
Actual ground colour, exposure, shadows and temporal antialiasing may change grass contrast and small-feature visibility; the transparent offline background is not native landscape evidence.
Terrain slope conformity, grounding and placement density in the real fields remain operator responsibilities.
No native runtime performance or memory measurement for tens of thousands of instances was performed.
Retain the seven raw diagnostic flags and these visual qualifications when describing readiness; offline readiness is not native acceptance.
